source: Word 16 PDF row rules + app CDP geometry, sample-real-proposal.docx
note: Word p32 = header (127 px) + tail of row 8 (150,4 px) + row 9 (567,3 px, ket thuc dung day trang). App = header 128 + tail row 8 151 + row 9 591 (thua 1 dong o o cao nhat) nen con 25 px cho hang 10 bat dau ngay tren p32, lech 1 trang so voi Word.
conclusion: 7 hang con lech bat dau som 1 trang vi o cao nhat cua hang truoc do wrap thua dung 1 dong (chenh ~0,5 px/tu giua Word GDI va Chrome).
